meta.title: Translate a document
meta.description: Upload a PDF or Word document, choose the languages, and download the translation — or edit it in the browser first.

upload.title: Translate a document
upload.description: Upload a PDF or Word document. Its layout is kept in the translation.
upload.hint: PDF or DOCX, up to {{size}} MB
upload.invalidType: This file type isn't supported. Choose a PDF or DOCX file.
upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{size}} MB. Choose a smaller file.
upload.empty: This file is empty. Choose another file.

languageStep.title: Choose the languages
languageStep.description: Which language is the document in, and which language do you need?

translating.title: Translating {{fileName}}
translating.description: From {{source}} to {{target}}. Longer documents can take a few minutes — keep this page open.

done.title: Your translation is ready
done.downloadDescription: Get the translated {{type}} as it is.
done.editDescription: Review the translation next to the original and correct any sentence.

error.title: The document couldn't be translated
error.description: Something went wrong while translating. Try again, or choose another file.

editor.notFoundDescription: It doesn't exist, or it was translated before editing was available. Translate the document again to edit it.
editor.loadErrorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
